source: GoogleTrendArchive: Google Trends 'Trending Now' national feeds for 125 countries, collected every 10 minutes, Nov. 27, 2024 to May 17, 2026. Topics merged by the world-attention pipeline.
note: Weather ('today' phrasings only; 'weather tomorrow' is left out). countries: each country's usual peak, the local hour and the UTC hour with the most weather trends over the archive (20+ trends; US, CA and RU from their regional feeds, each in its zone), its typical UTC offset and its most common phrasing. usual_day = mean countries where a weather trend started in each local hour (0-23), over the full-coverage days. days = every local day: flag (null = full coverage; 'gap' or next to one), countries starting a weather trend in each local hour, and the countries that did at 6 a.m.
takeaway: On a usual day, weather starts trending in about 20 countries at 6 a.m. local time.
